Ceremony scenario

Plan the Chinese wedding tea ceremony order.

Use this scenario when the family needs a clear sequence for serving tea, seating elders, and handling red envelopes.

Best forFamily ceremony
Main decisionOrder and roles
Products laterTea tray, cups, red envelopes
Open checklistAll resources

Sequence before style

Confirm the people involved before choosing decor. The order, seating, and red envelope moment matter more than the visual style of the tray.

Items to prepare

Prepare tea cups, tray, tea, cushions or chairs if needed, red envelopes, and a short order sheet for the couple or helper.
